provenance.rule: Reuse only t=7 and the scalar number of deletion profiles 128 to choose a distinct language input; no matrix or deletion record is consumed.

language_source.author: Alexander Okhotin
language_source.paper: Describing the syntax of programming languages using conjunctive and Boolean grammars

input.restriction: Only the first a-block length is bounded; later blocks and total word length are unbounded.

snapshot.language: a^n1 b ... a^nk b, k>=1, 0<=n1<=B, all later ni>=0 and ni!=n1

grammar.shape: terminal followed by zero or one nonterminal
